title: Workspace:Raycast()
summary: The modern raycasting API: cast from an origin along a direction vector (its magnitude = range), get back a RaycastResult with Instance/Position/Normal/Distance — or nil. Filter with RaycastParams.

reference.signature: Workspace:Raycast(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, raycastParams: RaycastParams?) --> RaycastResult?

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction AND range: the vector's magnitude is the ray's length. (lookVector * 300 = 300 studs)

parameters.name: raycastParams
parameters.description: Optional filter: FilterDescendantsInstances list + FilterType (Exclude/Include), IgnoreWater.

reference.returns: RaycastResult { Instance, Position, Normal, Distance, Material } or nil if nothing was hit.

details.heading: Filter semantics
details.body: Exclude: ray passes through the listed instances. Include: ONLY those instances can be hit. Use Exclude for your own character; Include for 'only hit targets'.

details.heading: Deprecated cousins
details.body: FindPartOnRay / Ray.new are legacy — migrate to Raycast for control and clarity.

explanation.whatItIs: An instant invisible laser: report what it touches first.
explanation.whyItExists: Hitscan weapons, line-of-sight checks, ground probes, selection tools — all are 'what's in this direction?'
whenToUse: Can the NPC see the player?
Finding the ground below a position
whenNotToUse: Physical projectiles that should bounce/interact — real parts with physics
tips: Direction vector's LENGTH is the range — the most common confusion
IgnoreWater = true unless water matters to you
commonMistakes: Passing an endpoint as direction (range becomes the small vector between points)
Raycasting on the client and trusting it server-side — re-validate server-side for authority

examples.title: Hitscan shot with validation pattern
examples.code:
-- Client: fires ray from camera through mouse
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 300

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.IgnoreWater = true

local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

-- Tell the server; the server RE-CASTS or validates distance/plausibility
shootRemote:FireServer(origin, direction.Unit * 300)
